reproduce.title: Retain saved settings across complete exit
prerequisites: Windows and a non-elevated PowerToys session
setup: Choose and record one reversible Settings preference.
steps: Change that preference and observe the saved state.
Exit PowerToys completely from the tray and restart it.
Check the same preference and compare on the current build.
reproduce.expected_result: The changed preference remains saved after a full exit and restart.

comment.body: Thanks for the report ZIP and for clarifying that this happens after fully closing PowerToys. Could you name one specific setting that changes back, its value before exit and after restarting, and the exact exit and restart steps? That will help distinguish this from the later module-enable report.
